title: S058 10.2.1.1 Setting the Expiration Interval of Contact Addresses
parent_path: S058 10.2.1.1 Setting the Expiration Interval of Contact Addresses

statements.subject: client
statements.description: When a client sends a REGISTER request, it MAY suggest an expiration interval that indicates how long the client would like the registration to be valid.
actions: include expiration interval suggestion in REGISTER request
